# Sparkle Nails

> Nail salon based in Austin, Texas. A nail salon on W Parmer Ln in North Austin. Gel manicures, spa pedicures, SNS dip, solar sets, French tips, chrome and cat-eye art, from techs clients ask for by name. Walk-ins welcome, open seven days.

- Phone: (512) 614-0999
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Pflugerville, Round Rock, Wells Branch, Cedar Park
- Google rating: 4.2 from 154 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/sparkle-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/sparkle-nails/book.html

## Services
- Manicures & gel: Classic and deluxe manicures, plus shellac gel that needs no drying time and won't smudge.
- Spa pedicures: Classic, deluxe and spa organic pedicures in a spa chair, from a quick polish to the full treatment.
- Signature spa pedicures: Pick your fragrance from the Volcano Spa and Collagen Spa menus and settle in for a longer soak.
- SNS dip powder: Signature Nail System dip powder: odorless, lightweight and glossy, and it holds up between visits.
- Solar & acrylic sets: Full sets and refills in solar, pink & white or color powder, at the length and shape you want.
- Nail art & chrome: Chrome, cat-eye, glitter, gems and hand-painted lines, from one accent nail to a full set.

## About
Sparkle Nails sits in suite 106 at 1701 W Parmer Ln, on the Parmer corridor in North Austin, and it has been a familiar name there for years. Walk in under the chandelier and you'll find a marble aisle, walls of polish on both sides and a row of spa pedicure chairs. It's open every day: 10 to 7 Monday through Saturday and 11:30 to 5 on Sundays. Regulars come back for the people. Clients ask for Vanna by name for consistent work every visit, drive back for Mymy's pedicures, and remember Jade for her patience while they changed their minds about shape and color. As one put it, a good job is nice, but great customer service gets etched in people's hearts.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Where is Sparkle Nails?
  A: Suite 106 at 1701 W Parmer Ln, Austin, TX 78727, in North Austin on the Parmer Ln corridor.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday 10 am to 7 pm, and Sunday 11:30 am to 5 pm. Holiday hours can differ, so call ahead on holidays.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To get a specific tech or a busy weekend time, call (512) 614-0999 and book ahead.
- Q: Can I ask for a specific nail tech?
  A: Yes. Many clients book with the same tech every visit. Mention who you'd like when you call.
- Q: Do you do dip powder and acrylic-style sets?
  A: Yes. Sparkle Nails does SNS dip powder (color, pink & white, French and ombre) and solar full sets and refills, plus gel, chrome and cat-eye.
- Q: Will I know the price before you start?
  A: Yes. Ask your tech to confirm the price of your service and any add-ons, like gel, chrome or nail art, before they begin.
- Q: How can I pay?
  A: Credit cards and Zelle are accepted.
